verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Feature Flags API that assigns users to variants for experiments, rollouts and releases, and its marketing describes running tests and rollouts alongside analytics. Nothing in the evidence shows how flags are targeted. Cohorts and properties appear only as analytics constructs, not as flag-targeting criteria. Missing for 10: documented targeting by user properties, cohort-based flag targeting, percentage rollout configuration, SDK/evaluation details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
